chapter_title: Concerning these Names: God, Rich One, and Angel;

3.original: [in the land of light, and there is no measure to]
3.content: in the land of light, and there is no measure to

fills.fill: in the land of Light, and there is no measure to apply to
fills.notes: The paragraph asserts the unmeasurability of the three archetypes. In ¶6 the same formula recurs explicitly (“There is no measure to apply to them!”), so the missing clause in ¶3 should match that fixed cosmological refrain in the oldest, impersonal register.

The triad is being defined by names/titles: gods → rich ones → angels (¶4–6). The contrast formula requires the substantive “rich ones” (a class), not an abstract “rich”. This also matches the later resumptive “They too, the rich ones…” (¶6) and keeps the correspondential hierarchy coherent (evocation of evocation).

assessment: Both lacunae are tightly constrained by internal parallelism. ¶3 repeats the fixed refrain about the immeasurable archetypes; ¶5 demands the plural class-title “rich ones” to preserve the three-tier emanation/evocation structure.
